lines.text: Sin entered the world through one man, and death came through sin, so death was passed on to all men.
Death reigned from Adam until Noah, even over those who did not sin the way Adam transgressed.
The gift is not like the trespass, and the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
One act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men, and through the obedience of one man many will be made righteous.
The law came in so that the trespass would increase, so that grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ.
